question: What claim about the scope of the teaching must hold if it concerns the whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: The teaching relates to all earth-moving yoginīs.
The teaching relates to all sky-moving yoginīs.
It relates to the whole field-group of these yoginīs.
inference: The subject matter is the complete field-group belonging to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The grammatical relation between the two compounds is not fully explicit from this verse alone.
plain_english: The whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
